label: Modern
detail: Our pick for casual play, closer to later Smash games: the right stick does smash attacks, Z-cancels happen automatically, and a music selection screen.

label: Competitive
detail: The community's competitive setup from BattleShip's own options: the competitive ruleset, neutral spawns on Dream Land, no stage hazards, no tap jump, right-stick smash attacks, and a flash on a missed Z-cancel.
